title: The Heavenly Dao Descends
next_chapter_hook: The cold countdown of the Heavenly Dao's Eye has begun. If Chen Ji fails to complete that impossible task in three months, what awaits him will be total annihilation.

text.content: At the exit of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Secret Realm, a figure stumbled out. Morning light fell upon Chen Ji's face, making his pallid, paper-white complexion appear even more morbid. His clothes were torn and shredded, several deep gashes still seeping blood, his left arm hanging at a bizarre angle, clearly broken. Only those eyes remained clear like an ancient well, unfathomably deep. Behind him, the secret realm's entrance slowly closed with a沉闷 rumble, like a behemoth shutting its fanged maw.

"Finally... out." Chen Ji murmured, his voice hoarse as if scraped from the depths of his throat. He had thought the life-and-death struggle within the secret realm was the greatest trial of this journey, yet he never knew true despair was waiting for him in the heavens. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled within the Tianji Record, sending out a barely audible warning: "It... has come."

Before the words even finished, the sky suddenly darkened. Not from storm clouds, but a true, absolute darkness, as if someone had taken heaven and earth as canvas, draping an nonexistent black veil over the entire heavens. Then, an eye slowly opened at the zenith of the sky—that pupil so vast it could cover half the sky, with billions of thunderbolts furiously brewing within, producing deafening roars.

dialogue.content: "Insignificant creature... You finally dare to step out of that confined space." The voice did not emerge from a mouth but resounded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, ancient, majestic, devoid of any emotion, as if the Heavenly Dao itself was pronouncing judgment. An invisible pressure like a collapsing mountain crashed down, the mountain stones beneath Chen Ji's feet instantly shattering, web-like cracks spreading in all directions.

text.content: Chen Ji's spine cracked under that pressure, his knees nearly buckling into the ground. His teeth gnashed together, blood seeping from the corners of his mouth, staining his chest. But his gaze remained calm, and within that calmness hid a hint of mockery incomprehensible to ordinary people. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out: "It's the Heavenly Dao's本体意识! It's personally intervening!"

"Is that all?" Chen Ji's voice sounded unusually hoarse under the pressure, yet each word was crystal clear. He slowly raised his head, gazing directly at that eye blocking the heavens, the corner of his mouth even forming a mocking curve. In the next instant, a majestic bloodline power erupted from within him, jet-black True Qi rising like beacon fires, actually forcing that pressure to part by a crack.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye's pupil slightly constricted, those billions of thunderbolts seemingly freezing for a moment. It seemed to have not expected that this creature it deemed insignificant could stand firm under its primordial pressure. Around Chen Ji, a blurry shadow flickered in and out of existence—that was the ancient bloodline just awakened within the secret realm, frantically devouring the Heavenly Dao laws contained within the pressure, converting them for its own use.

Chen Ji slowly straightened up, his broken left arm hanging at his side, blood dripping from his fingertips, hitting the ground in dark red flowers. But his aura was攀升 at an unbelievable speed, the Foundation Building realm's气息 shattering like bubbles, revealing his true cultivation beneath—Transcendent Divinity realm! No, even deeper, more obscure, more terrifying power!

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice remained cold, but carried a hint of amusement, "You're far more amusing than those chess pieces you eliminated. But do you think this is enough?" Before the words finished, the pressure suddenly increased tenfold! The mountain stones beneath Chen Ji's feet shattered into powder, his entire body pressed so hard it nearly embedded into the earth, blood simultaneously bleeding from all seven orifices.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to be completely crushed, an aged voice emerged from the Tianji Record, echoing in all directions: "Enough, Heavenly Dao." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul power erupted completely, forming a thin as cicada wings light screen around Chen Ji, actually bearing that tenfold pressure! "You're looking for a person, not crushing an ant. The Heavenly Dao also has its operating rules, does it not?"

dialogue.content: A cold glint flickered in the Heavenly Dao's Eye's pupil: "Rules? This One is the rules." Its voice carried a hint of disdain, "But since you wish to see what value this insect possesses..." The pressure suddenly withdrew. Chen Ji felt his body lighten, nearly stumbling. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice turned ice-cold and grim: "Three months. Within three months, complete the task This One has given you."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's pressure slightly retreated, giving Chen Ji a chance to catch his breath. At this moment, he must make a choice—

choices.description: Using the newly awakened bloodline power as backing, directly question the truth of the Heavenly Dao's Eye's task, and fight for initiative without any concessions.
choices.visible_cost: May consume bloodline power, potentially anger the Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: May obtain more information about the task
choices.risk_hint: High risk: may provoke stronger suppression

text.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from his mouth corner, gazing directly at that celestial eye, and snorted coldly: "Three months? Does the Heavenly Dao also have time limits and quotas? Are you afraid you can't find a second puppet?" His voice echoed through the valley, carrying undisguised mockery.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's pupil abruptly constricted, those billions of thunderbolts all roared in unison, like an enraged primordial beast. But the next moment, that pressure withdrew, replaced by an eerie silence. After a long while, that cold voice rang out again: "Interesting. You are the first existence to dare question This One."

choices.description: Temporarily sheathe your edge, present yourself as a废物, let the Heavenly Dao's Eye relax its guard, and secretly seek a way to break the situation.
choices.visible_cost: Need to suppress anger, drain mental energy
choices.risk_hint: Low risk: may cause enemies to underestimate you

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze instantly dimmed, his posture slightly hunched, reverting to that sickly appearance. He lowered his head, his voice weak and trembling: "This... this subordinate understands. May I ask what the Heavenly Dao Lord wishes this subordinate to do?"

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze swept over Chen Ji, seemingly examining something. After a moment, it let out an ambiguous冷哼: "Indeed an insect, no matter how it struggles, it cannot change the mediocrity in its bones." That voice carried naked contempt, "In three months, This One will seek you again. By then... you better give This One a surprise."

choices.description: Neither confront directly nor show weakness, but use rhetoric to steer the conflict in another direction, letting the Heavenly Dao's Eye voluntarily reveal more information.
choices.visible_reward: May extract key clues about the task
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk: failed rhetoric may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, he coughed twice, and said in a weak yet clear voice: "This subordinate is unworthy, but there is one thing unclear. Since the Heavenly Dao Lord wishes this subordinate to serve, shouldn't this subordinate at least know... what is the price of this service? Otherwise, wouldn't this subordinate die without understanding why?"

dialogue.content: A playful glint flickered in the Heavenly Dao's Eye's pupil, seemingly intrigued by this human who dared play tricks before it: "You are rather clever. Rest assured, This One will not make you exert yourself for nothing. In three months, you must travel to the Northern Depths Forbidden Grounds and retrieve something—the final page of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the Heavenly Dao's Eye gave the same verdict. That cold voice echoed in his Mental Sea, each word like a nail driven into his soul: "Three months. Within three months, arrive at the Northern Depths Forbidden Grounds and retrieve the final page of the Tianji Record. Complete it, and This One shall grant you the truth. Fail..." Thunder suddenly erupted within that enormous pupil, "and This One shall teach you what true annihilation means."

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. The Northern Depths Forbidden Grounds—that was a primordial forbidden land from which legend said not even cultivators at the Great Ascension realm could return alive. It was rumored that something capable of destroying the entire cultivation world was sealed there. The Heavenly Dao's Eye sending him to retrieve the final page of the Tianji Record—this wasn't asking him to complete a task, it was clearly sending him to his death!

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his mind, carrying a hint of imperceptible gravity: "Chen Ji, the final page of the Tianji Record... that is a taboo even your master could not touch. Opening the Northern Depths Forbidden Grounds requires three keys, one of which lies with Tianqing Sect's old Sect Master, Ling Yuan." He paused, his voice becoming meaningful, "It seems some people cannot wait any longer."

text.content: A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Ling Yuan—that old Sect Master who outwardly sheltered him but secretly harbored malicious intent. The previous generation candidate for the Tianji Record's inheritance, filled with resentment after being passed over by the Tianji Record. It seemed the Heavenly Dao's Eye choosing him was no coincidence; Ling Yuan's underhanded movements were no coincidence either. Everything was within some grander chess game.

Just then, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's pressure began to slowly dissipate. That eye blocking the heavens gradually became transparent, as if dissolving into the Void. But before completely vanishing, that cold voice rang out once more, this time carrying a meaningful warning: "By the way, This One has sensed a person... someone capable of interfering with Heavenly Secrets. That person's aura is on you."

Chen Ji's heart violently contracted. The only thing on him that could interfere with Heavenly Secrets' foresight was that jade pendant he had always kept close to his body—with his sister Chen Nian's aura still lingering on it. The Heavenly Dao's Eye actually detected even this? He forcibly suppressed the turbulent waves in his heart, maintaining that废物 appearance on the surface, but his tightly clenched fists had already pierced his palms, blood dripping between his fingers.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice gradually faded into the distance, "This One wonders just how far this flawed chess piece can go. Three months... This One awaits." As the words fell, that eye completely dissolved into the Void. The blocked celestial light once again poured down, yet seemed especially glaring, as if mocking that brief confrontation between insect and Heavenly Dao.

text.content: Chen Ji stood alone atop the collapsed mountaintop, clothes fluttering in the wind, bloodstained. The three-month deadline hung like a sword above his head, ready to fall at any moment. But the light in his eyes burned brighter than ever before. He slowly raised his head, gazing toward the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak, the corner of his mouth curving into a meaningful arc: "Three months... will be enough."
